description: Triggers a phone call test run for a specific suite. This will initiate phone calls for all scenarios configured in the suite.

accessKey.description: Access key for Basic Auth (optional, uses authenticated credentials if not provided)

projectId.description: The project ID that contains the suite

suiteName.description: The name of the suite to trigger

username.description: Username for Basic Auth (optional, uses authenticated user if not provided)

name: triggerSuiteRun

success.description: Whether the call initiation was successful

title: Trigger Suite Run
